dosing.evidence: TCB-2 and MDL-100,907 were diluted ... as free base in NaCl 0.9 % ... TCB-2/vehicle i.p. (7.5 mL/kg)
MDL-100,907 (0.2 mg/kg)/vehicle was injected i.p. (5 mL/kg), 15 min prior to TCB-2/vehicle; Tween 0.3 % in NaCl 0.9 %

group_housing.evidence: Animals were kept in the animal facility ... with access to standard chow and water ad libitum (cage density not stated)

day_night_flipped.evidence: under a 12 h light/dark cycle (light 7:00-19:00); testing between 11 am and 2 pm

assays.assay_description: Mice placed in an isolated chamber (33x33x25 cm); head twitches counted for 1 min at 20, 30, 40, and 50 min post TCB-2/vehicle, with or without MDL-100,907 pretreatment.

application_type.evidence: TCB-2/vehicle i.p. (7.5 mL/kg); MDL-100,907 ... injected i.p.

setup_habituation.evidence: Following MDL-100,907 or vehicle administration mice were placed in an isolated chamber ... and injected with TCB-2 or vehicle 15 min later.

setup_restrain.evidence: mice were placed in an isolated chamber (33x33x25cm) for behavioral observation

food_restriction.evidence: Test conducted in an isolated observation chamber; no food in apparatus.

water_restriction.evidence: Test conducted in an isolated observation chamber; no water in apparatus.

time_to_assay.evidence: The HTR was observed for 1 min at 20-, 30-, 40- and 50-min post TCB-2 or vehicle

sample_size.evidence: one-way ANOVA F(3,31) = 44.36 implies ~35 mice across 4 groups; n = 6-11 per group reported elsewhere

outcomes.summary: TCB-2 increased HTR relative to vehicle, with the largest effect at 3 mg/kg; the response peaked at 20 min and declined by 50 min. Pretreatment with MDL-100,907 (0.2 mg/kg) blocked the HTR induced by 3 mg/kg TCB-2.
outcomes.evidence: TCB-2 increased HTR relative to vehicle-treated mice, with the largest increase observed after 3 mg/kg TCB-2 ... HTR peaked at 20 min post-injection [F(3,31) = 44.36, p < 0.01] and progressively decreased until 50 min ... Pretreatment with MDL-100,907 blocked the effect of 3 mg/kg TCB-2 at t20, t30, and t40 [F(1, 36) = 28.26, p < 0.001].

B1_num_measures.evidence: Only HTR count was measured (same measure at multiple timepoints)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: HTR peaked at 20 min post-injection and progressively decreased until 50 min post-injection (binned across the session).

B4_ethological.evidence: Head-twitch response is a drug-induced stereotypy, explicitly excluded from ethological behaviours.

B5_social.evidence: mice were placed in an isolated chamber

B6_cognitive.evidence: HTR is reflexive, requires no learning.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: HTR observed manually; no computational classifier mentioned.

E2_shelter.evidence: no enclosed refuge in the observation chamber

E5_enrichment.evidence: no enrichment objects in observation chamber

E7_social_context.evidence: mice were placed in an isolated chamber

D1_continuity.evidence: HTR was observed for 1 min at 20-, 30-, 40- and 50-min post TCB-2 (four discrete 1-min observation windows).

D3_recording_days.evidence: All HTR measurements performed on a single day per animal prior to sacrifice 60 min after injection.

D5_followup.evidence: Sacrifice 60 min after agonist injection; no follow-up.

D6_circadian.evidence: Each observation = 1 min; no session ≥6 h.

assays.assay_description: After HTR observation, the Perspex floor of the isolated chamber (33x33x25 cm) was replaced with a novel textured floor composed of four distinct textures (red felt, brown hessian, white sponge, orange microfiber chenille). Mice were exposed for 10 min prior to sacrifice; this exposure was used to mobilize an 'exploratory' brain state for subsequent post-mortem neurochemistry. No behavioural quantification is reported.

setup_habituation.evidence: The textured floor was novel; mice had only previously been in the same chamber with a Perspex floor for HTR.

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice were exposed to the textured floor for 10 min (freely moving).

food_restriction.evidence: No food present in observation chamber during exploration.

water_restriction.evidence: No water present in observation chamber during exploration.

time_to_assay.evidence: Forced exploratory behavior was assessed 50 min after TCB-2 or vehicle administration.

sample_size.evidence: ensuring n > 6 and significance set at p < 0.05; n = 6-11

outcomes.summary: Forced exposure to a novel textured floor was used to elicit an exploratory state prior to sacrifice. No behavioural metrics are reported for this exposure; the authors describe the resulting neurochemical correlation patterns rather than overt behaviour.
outcomes.evidence: Mice were exposed to the textured floor for 10 min prior to sacrifice, comprising a period of forced exploratory behavior.

B1_num_measures.evidence: No behavioural measures explicitly quantified for the exploration period.

B4_ethological.evidence: Forced exploratory behavior on a textured substrate – natural exploratory behaviour.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Innate exploration of novelty; no learning required.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Multivariate analysis applied to post-mortem neurochemistry, not to behavioural features.

E1_environment_type.evidence: novel 'textured' floor composed of four distinct textures: red felt, brown hessian, white sponge, and orange microfiber chenille

E3_bedding.evidence: Floor surface composed of red felt, brown hessian, white sponge, and orange microfiber chenille (substrate covering the apparatus floor).

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects; textured floor is the novelty stimulus rather than enrichment objects.

E6_spatial.evidence: Single isolated chamber (33x33x25cm) with no internal partitions.

D1_continuity.evidence: Mice were exposed to the textured floor for 10 min prior to sacrifice.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Single exposure on day of sacrifice.

judge_notes: Two assays retained: HTR and Forced Exploration on textured floor. Although no behavioural measures are quantified for the exploration period, the paper explicitly frames it as a behavioural 'forced exploration' protocol used to drive an exploratory state; included it as a behavioural assay following candidate glm.

B2 (HTR temporal dynamics) scored 1: paper presents minute-by-minute style time-course across 20/30/40/50 min within the session, consistent with within-session temporal binning (candidates glm and gptoss agreed).
B1 (HTR) scored 0 (only HTR count was reported); gptoss's B1=2 reflected timepoints rather than distinct measures and was rejected.

Textured floor: E3 (bedding/substrate) scored 1 because the four textile materials physically cover the apparatus floor as a substrate; E1 scored 2 (enriched arena) as the chamber was modified with added textural features beyond the standard Perspex floor.
Dosing: added MDL-100,907 as a second compound entry per rubric (it is a 5-HT2A antagonist co-administered with the psychedelic agonist).
Day/night cycle scored 'no' (not flipped): lights on 07:00-19:00 and testing 11 am-2 pm = standard light-phase testing.
